items.message: GATE-MODEL-1 is added as `unmet` and blocks O11, but the diff contains no change to `ai/bootstrap.py`, `ai/structured.py`, or any routing code — the gap it describes (ModelCaps.structured_output declared but read by nothing) is unchanged by this PR.

The new 'Held, and cited by nothing' section references #273 as the fix for held gates that serve no stated direction, but the diff does not show any change that closes or advances #273 — only that it is filed.

The `resolve()` loop previously applied `max_turns` in the same `replace()` call as the three credit fields; after deletion, `max_turns` is applied alone. This is correct, but the method now silently drops any `max_turns` contributed before the `deny_tools`/`scan_input` block because the per-layer logic processes `deny_tools` and `scan_input` conditionally and then unconditionally replaces `max_turns` — so a layer with no `deny_tools` or `scan_input` still applies its `max_turns`. That behavior …[truncated]

The shape assertion pins the exact field set of Policy and ResolvedPolicy. This is the right instrument for GATE-POLICY-2, and it will catch a new inert field immediately. One gap: it does not assert that every field in ResolvedPolicy is actually consumed by InvokePolicy.under() — the structural check is necessary but not sufficient for the gate's claim.
